data.name: Anavi
data.gender_notes: Anavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anavam’ which means ‘graceful goddess’. In Hindu mythology, Anavi is a form of Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and art. The name Anavi carries the meaning “Graceful Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anavi usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anavi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
